notice:
The HSK 3.0 words are the official word list (HSK 词汇大纲) of the 《HSK 考试大纲》 Syllabus for the Chinese Proficiency Test, edition published 2025-11 and effective 2026-07. Words badge with their level, and the character map's word grouping puts each character at the lowest level of a word written with it.

Source: [www.chinesetest.cn](https://www.chinesetest.cn) — reproduced from the Chinese Test Service Website (CTI); syllabus published by CLEC (中外语言交流合作中心). No reuse licence is granted: the site's [Legal Notice](https://www.chinesetest.cn/legal-notice) says its content is copyrighted by CTI or the content providers, requires the source to be indicated, and permits reproduction only as reasonable, good-faith quoting for informative public use. The syllabus PDF carries a copy-protection flag. This pack includes only the vocabulary (word) list, as a plain list of words with their levels and pinyin readings; it does not include the syllabus's descriptions, task and topic lists, or explanatory text. The Chinese grammar pack, when installed, is listed separately in the Sources page's Grammar lessons section and uses the syllabus's grammar outline as a topic index. The project includes the word and character lists with this attribution at the project owner's decision; the legal status of including these lists has not been verified.
